reviewScope: The four model-visible tools required by the release-candidate contract. The API catalog is documentation-only and cannot execute account API requests. The separately reviewed eight-tool app-only contract for Number Intelligence and Voice Monitor is intentionally excluded from this annotation-justification document. The internal billing app is not publicly federated.
